builds.name: Colossal Smash: AD and MR crossover
builds.summary: Investigate a high Colossal Smash magic attack event result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate a high Colossal Smash magic attack event result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Colossal Smash contains a level-based base plus total AD + 0.4 AP + 0.6 bonus MR as magic damage. Flat AD therefore directly competes with AP and bonus MR for the chosen hit. Banshee supports both AP and MR terms; Jak'Sho requires earned ramp. The total-AD term is already attack delivery inside this packet, not permission to add another full physical attack.
